title: Tech Note: 4D Database Recovery Options – Part I
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The core disaster-recovery mechanisms described — MSC Verify/Repair, the backup system, restore/rollback, and mirroring for failover — remain part of 4D's data-protection story today, so the overall guidance is still broadly applicable. However, the note is framed entirely around the classic binary .4DB/.4DD structure file model that predates Project Mode (introduced v17/2018+), and some UI/workflow details for MSC and mirroring have evolved since 4D v16.
related_updates: 4D's backup, log file, and mirror architecture is largely still in place conceptually in modern 4D Server
Project Mode (.4DProject, text-based) changes how structure files are stored/versioned, altering some recovery scenarios not covered here
MSC interface and options have been refined in newer 4D releases
